purpose: Machine-readable semantics separating defect detection from actual prevention enforcement.
rule: A legacy guarded defect is detection-only unless explicit enforcement evidence upgrades it. Prevented requires local, hosted, and merge enforcement and recurrence escalation.

PRH-007.hosted: Hunter / Pre-PR Preflight and CI both execute the canonical shared preflight on pushed exact HEAD
PRH-007.merge: Required Quality Gates plus Hunter Merge Readiness remain independent merge controls
PRH-007.recurrence: Any pushed-head recurrence is a prevention-system failure and requires enforcement-gap correction
